name: Stacked area chart
purpose: Trend over time as cumulative stacked fills, multi-series — line-family frame/toolbar ported from Chart-line.reference.html (2026-07-23 exemplar), stacking recipe (cumulative bands, in-fill letter keys, table Total column) ported from Chart-bar.reference.html's stacked-column figure (D-Q3, landed 2026-07-24, consumed here not re-promoted). New member, wave-2 lane ③ (2026-08-05).

props.name: series
props.$note: 1–5 supported by the token ramp; 3 in the reference. Each band carries colour (data/series/N) + an in-fill letter key (A/B/C, data/text/on-series) — colour is never the only channel.

props.name: data
props.$note: Real <table class="dv-table"> in the figure (dv-005), surfaced by the table-view popover panel. Mirrors PER-SERIES values plus a computed Total column (the bands' sum) — parity between chart and table is scriptable the same way as the stacked-column check.

props.name: fillAlpha
props.$note: --stack-fill-alpha, default 1 (flat/solid). NOT a minted token — a receipted CSS dial so band opacity can be tuned later without a token-minting pass (token minting stays a serial/conductor act).
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C9 -- bind:family. Binds to the alpha family (opacity primitives, ds-026 amended -- CANON), not one fixed step. Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

props.name: empty
props.$note: No-data state = the Empty-state pattern by reference.

props.name: title
props.$note: Optional visible title slot (.dv-title, dv-006), a type composite heading; sr-only figcaption still names the chart when absent.

props.name: tablePopover
props.$note: Table-view POPOVER panel, ported from the line exemplar verbatim.

props.name: legendFilter
props.$note: DV-D11 legend chrome, plain swatches (band identity is the in-fill letter, not a legend glyph — matches Chart-bar's stacked-column legend, not Chart-line's shaped-swatch set).

props.name: highContrast
props.$note: data-contrast="high" remaps series onto data/series-high-contrast/* (token rebind only).
props.$status: s142-D1 (Dave, 2026-08-10) class C9 -- bind. data-contrast="high" remaps series onto this token (kit pattern, v2-recommended, ratified). Record: reviews/BINDS-AUTHORING-VERDICTS-2026-08-10-s142-v3.json.

variants.name: 3-series stack
variants.use: Quarterly composition of a total (e.g. balances by product), one band per series, cumulative.

variants.name: no data
variants.use: Empty-state pattern in the chart frame.

tokens.font-family: type composites via markup class — DV-D08 ladder: axis ticks + on-chart values .t-cm-chart-value (12/500 tabular) · quarter labels + legend text .t-cm-chart-label (12/500) · in-fill/legend letter-keys .t-cm-chart-key (12/700); table .t-cm-legal; title .t-cm-section-label
tokens.onSeriesText: data/text/on-series (minted 2026-07-27 for Chart-bar's stacked columns — REUSED here, not re-minted)
tokens.axis: ds-020 FENCE — data/axis + data/grid roles, CSS copied verbatim from Chart-line (not re-derived by this lane; receipted as an inherited gap, not filled)
tokens.markers: fill = the series token, stroke = background/default (page) at 2.5 — line exemplar's BACKGROUND mode, halation-aware on dark
tokens.$survey: ONE new CSS var, not a token: --stack-fill-alpha (default 1). No new colour token minted. #96-D3: adjacent bands now carry a 2px page-coloured stroke (.dv-band) — standing dataviz separation rule, same idiom as dv-004's donut/pie segment strokes and histogram's wave-2 bin stroke.

motion.entry: Bands fade in (400ms), top-edge strokes follow (+400ms delay), markers (+500ms), in-fill keys (+600ms) — a staggered reveal built for this file, distinct from the line's dasharray draw (an area fill can't stroke-draw the same way); CSS-only, DEF-003 compliant.
motion.hover: Interactive value POPOVER (dvTip) on each vertex marker — same delegated behaviour partial as every other member, once registered.
motion.reducedMotion: Global collapse present; entry fades sit inside prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference.

responsive.rule: Declared data-fx fractions on all elements (grid/axis/markers/keys/labels) for the standard fit hook, but .dv-band/.dv-band-line are NEW element classes the current dv-behaviour fitOne() selector set does not touch — until that's extended, the chart is JS-off-fixed-width (580×260 + scroll), same static answer as every member pre-fit. Receipted to the conductor, not built here.

accessibility.role: figure role="group" + aria-labelledby → sr-only figcaption; svg role="group" + aria-label; table panel role="region".
accessibility.name: Figcaption names the chart; markers carry aria-label == data-tip == table values (PER-SERIES, not cumulative); the real table is the full data surface with a Total column.
accessibility.keyboard: Markers = focus stops (tabindex 0 + aria-label; popover shows on focus). Legend filter buttons + table toggle keyboard-operable; panel takes focus on open (tabindex -1), Esc returns to toggle.
accessibility.nonText: Band fills ≥3:1 vs the page both modes (inherited series tokens, dv-016); identity = in-fill letter + legend name + table, never colour alone.

antiPatterns: Curved/smoothed band boundaries (dv-line-011 — straight segments only)
Colour as the only band identity (in-fill letter + legend name + table, always)
A stacked area without its real data table + Total column (dv-005-adjacent)
Legend filter hiding a middle band without declaring the reflow gap (same known caveat as Chart-bar's stacked columns — bands don't reflow on filter)
Minting a new opacity token for the fill instead of using --stack-fill-alpha (receipted CSS dial, not a token)
Re-deriving the axis/grid CSS instead of citing the ds-020 fence inherited from Chart-line
Re-typing dv-behaviour locally (ADR-0015 — consume the AUTO-BEHAVIOUR partial once registered)
